--> About | Petite Fleur Studio top of page Home About Designs Contact More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. The Petite Fleur Story Created by long time illustrator and surface pattern designer, Alice Potter, Petite Fleur studio is a new print and pattern studio specialising in prints for small people. Alice has almost a decades experience as an illustrator and licensed artist. She lives between London and France with her partner and daughter. Petite Fleur comes out of a love of design for kids which Alice has been excited about for many years. You will always find her browsing in kids stores wherever she is, looking for inspiration and quite possibly buying something that she claims is for her daughter, but in reality it's for her. We can't wait to share our new collection of prints with you. ​ Looking for custom work? Contact us here today so we can start discussing your project. ​ Want to discover my children's book illustrations and art available for licensing? Visit my illustration website here . ​ Clients Abacus Card, American Greetings, Auzou, Charlesbridge, Cottage Door Press, Igloo Books, CBeebies Magazine, YoYo Books, Harper Collins US, Papercrafter Magazine, Papyrus Cards, Magi Cards, Raleigh Bikes UK, WH Smith, Quarto Publishing, I Am A Bookworm, Hallmark US, Graphique de France, Picollina Kids, Hollan Publishing, Little Sleepies, UK Greetings, Design Design DDI, Clementoni Toys, Salariya Book Company, Pigment Productions, Greetings Island, Boots Miniclub Our Work ©2025 by Petite Fleur Studio. Proudly created with Wix.com bottom of page
